name: Kit Anger
description: Kit Anger is closely connected to the Navi and takes particular interest in matters involving their history, the journal, and the Mother’s Prayer prophecy. He pays close attention to Gerk after Gerk’s connection to the prophecy is revealed, and he welcomes Gerk as a brother after Gerk becomes a Child of the Great Eldarin Tree. Kit is also willing to step aside to allow important ceremonies to proceed and has taken responsibility for stewarding the unchosen Turof and La-rel keystones until future keepers assume their mantles.

log.summary: Kit Anger became particularly attentive when Sylan discussed the Navi, the journal, and Gerk’s connection to the prophecy, then examined Gerk more closely after his link to the Mother’s Prayer was revealed. Kit stepped back with Juten Prime to allow the ceremony to proceed and later welcomed Gerk as a brother after Gerk became a Child of the Great Eldarin Tree. Kit will also help steward the unchosen Turof and La-rel keystones alongside the DM until future keepers take up their mantles.
